canonical_title: GlobalFoundries and Marvell expand SiGe capacity for AI data-center optical connectivity
aliases: GlobalFoundries Marvell AI data center connectivity
treatment: Repeat only for quantified capacity, production milestones, customer deployments, higher-speed roadmap details, or material schedule changes.
known_facts: GlobalFoundries and Marvell announced an expanded multi-year agreement to increase SiGe manufacturing capacity at GlobalFoundries' Burlington, Vermont facility.
The capacity supports AI data-center optical connectivity including pluggable transceivers, Near-Packaged Optics and Co-Packaged Optics.
GlobalFoundries says its current SiGe technology supports 200G-per-lane optical connectivity and has a roadmap for higher-speed generations.
reinclude_only_if: The companies quantify the added manufacturing capacity or investment.
A production or deployment milestone is announced for NPO or CPO products.
GlobalFoundries or Marvell discloses materially new higher-speed optical specifications or customers.
notes: Official announcement published September 17, 2026 at 08:35 ET, within the Night Lite coverage window.
